title: Harbour at first light
description: A fishing harbour at dawn. The camera pushes slowly along the quay; mist lifts off still water and gulls cross the frame.
prompt: A slow push along a fishing harbour at first light, mist lifting off the water, gulls crossing the frame, 35mm, shallow focus

title: Glaze, turning
description: A ceramic bowl turning on a wheel beside a window. Wet glaze catches the light through one rotation.
prompt: Animate this photo of a ceramic bowl: the wheel turns one full rotation while wet glaze catches the window light

title: Night run, tracking shot
description: A runner on a wet city street at night, followed from the side. Neon signs reflect in the road.
prompt: Tracking shot beside a runner on a wet city street at night, neon reflections, steady pace, breath visible

title: Orchard from above
description: An aerial descent over rows of apple trees in low autumn sun. Leaves move in a light wind.

title: Kitchen, restyled live

title: Tide pool, macro
